Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 1) In kidney disease, metformin should be used cautiously because of risk of:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Metformin may cause lactic acidosis in kidney disease. Reduced renal function increases risk. Renal status should be checked before and during therapy.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 2) In liver disease, metformin may also increase risk of:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Metformin can cause lactic acidosis in hepatic disease too. Liver dysfunction may impair lactate handling. Risk-benefit assessment is needed before prescribing.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 3) Sulfonylureas and insulin in kidney disease may cause:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Kidney disease can enhance hypoglycaemic effect. Sulfonylureas and insulin need caution. Dose adjustment and glucose monitoring are important.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 4) Sulfonylureas in liver disease may cause:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Hepatic disease can increase sulfonylurea-related hypoglycaemia risk. Drug metabolism may be impaired. Blood glucose monitoring is needed.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 5) NSAIDs in kidney disease may worsen:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: NSAIDs may impair renal function. Risk is higher in pre-existing kidney disease. They should be avoided or used carefully with monitoring.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 6) NSAIDs in liver disease may increase risk of:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: NSAIDs may cause GI bleeding. In liver disease, bleeding risk and fluid retention are important. They should be prescribed cautiously.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 7) ACE inhibitors and ARBs in kidney disease may cause:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: ACEIs and ARBs can raise potassium. They may also worsen renal function in susceptible patients. Creatinine and potassium monitoring are important.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 8) Spironolactone in kidney disease may cause:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Spironolactone is potassium-sparing. Kidney disease reduces potassium excretion. This combination increases hyperkalaemia risk.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 9) Benzodiazepines in kidney disease may cause enhanced risk of:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Benzodiazepine effect may be enhanced in kidney disease. Sedation can become excessive. Severe toxicity may lead to coma.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 10) Chloramphenicol in liver disease may cause enhanced risk of:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Liver disease increases risk with chloramphenicol. Bone marrow suppression is an important adverse effect. Use requires caution and monitoring.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 11) Warfarin in liver disease may cause:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Liver disease can increase warfarin effect. Clotting factor synthesis is impaired. Bleeding risk becomes higher.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 12) Reduced clearance in kidney disease is important for:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Opioid clearance may be reduced in kidney disease. Accumulation increases sedation and respiratory depression risk. Dose choice should be individualized.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 13) Reduced clearance in liver disease is also important for:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Liver disease can reduce opioid clearance. This increases risk of sedation and respiratory depression. Lower doses or safer alternatives may be needed.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 14) Which cardiovascular drug has reduced clearance in kidney disease?
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Digoxin clearance is reduced in kidney disease. Accumulation can cause arrhythmia, GI symptoms and visual disturbance. Renal function and serum levels may need monitoring.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 15) Which CNS drug has reduced clearance in kidney disease?
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Lithium is cleared mainly by kidney. Kidney disease increases lithium toxicity risk. Serum lithium and renal function monitoring are essential.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 16) Which antibiotic has reduced clearance in kidney disease?
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Aminoglycosides need caution in renal impairment. Reduced clearance increases nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity risk. Dose adjustment and monitoring are important.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 17) Which drug has reduced clearance in liver disease?
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Propranolol clearance is reduced in liver disease. It undergoes hepatic handling. Dose adjustment may be required.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 18) Which local anesthetic has reduced clearance in liver disease?
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Lidocaine clearance is reduced in liver disease. It is mainly metabolized by liver. Toxicity risk increases when hepatic metabolism is impaired.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 19) Which antiepileptic has reduced clearance in liver disease?
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Phenytoin clearance is reduced in liver disease. It has narrow therapeutic range. Small changes in level can cause toxicity.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 20) Which benzodiazepine has reduced clearance in liver disease?
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Diazepam is hepatically metabolized. Liver disease may prolong its action. Excess sedation and accumulation may occur.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 21) Primaquine in G6PD deficiency may cause:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Primaquine is a high-yield haemolysis-causing drug in G6PD deficiency. Oxidative stress triggers red cell breakdown. It should be avoided or used with strict caution.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 22) Which antimalarial may cause haemolysis in G6PD deficiency?
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Chloroquine is listed among antimalarials risky in G6PD deficiency. Other examples include primaquine, quinine and proguanil. Haemolysis risk varies with drug and patient factors.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 23) Which sulfa-related drug may cause haemolysis in G6PD deficiency?
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Cotrimoxazole is a sulfa-related drug. Sulfonamides can trigger haemolysis in G6PD deficiency. Alternative drugs should be considered when possible.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 24) Which antibiotic may cause haemolysis in G6PD deficiency?
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Nitrofurantoin is risky in G6PD deficiency. It may trigger oxidative haemolysis. Dapsone and chloramphenicol are also listed.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 25) Dapsone in G6PD deficiency is associated with:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Dapsone can cause haemolysis in G6PD deficiency. It is a high-yield drug in this context. Avoidance or careful monitoring is needed.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 26) Methylene blue in G6PD deficiency may cause:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Methylene blue is listed among drugs risky in G6PD deficiency. It may worsen haemolysis. This is important because it may be considered in methemoglobinemia.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 27) Which drug group may cause haemolysis in G6PD deficiency?
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Sulfonamides are classic oxidative drugs. They may cause haemolysis in G6PD deficiency. Cotrimoxazole and sulfasalazine are examples.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 28) Which drug is risky in G6PD deficiency?
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: High-dose aspirin is listed among drugs that may cause haemolysis in G6PD deficiency. Dose matters clinically. Safer alternatives should be considered.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 29) Which vitamin-related drug is risky in G6PD deficiency?
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Menadione is vitamin K₃. It may cause haemolysis in G6PD deficiency. This is a classic caution point.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 30) Which antihypertensive is listed as risky in G6PD deficiency?
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Hydralazine is listed among drugs with haemolysis potential in G6PD deficiency. Methyldopa is also listed. Drug history is important in haemolytic episodes.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 31) Which antiarrhythmic-related drug is risky in G6PD deficiency?
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Procainamide is listed among G6PD-risk drugs. It may contribute to haemolysis. G6PD status should be considered in susceptible patients.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 32) Which gout-related drug is risky in G6PD deficiency?
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Probenecid is listed among drugs risky in G6PD deficiency. Colchicine is also listed. These drugs may contribute to haemolysis in susceptible patients.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 33) Antimicrobial needing dose reduction even in mild renal failure is:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Aminoglycosides need dose reduction even in mild renal failure. They are nephrotoxic and renally cleared. Therapeutic monitoring may be required.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 34) Which drug needs dose reduction even in mild renal failure?
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Cephalexin is listed for dose reduction even in mild renal failure. Renal excretion is clinically important. Dose adjustment reduces toxicity.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 35) Ethambutol dose reduction is needed:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Ethambutol needs dose reduction in mild renal failure. Accumulation increases toxicity risk. Visual monitoring remains important.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 36) Vancomycin dose reduction is needed:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Vancomycin is renally cleared. Dose reduction is needed even in mild renal failure. Monitoring helps prevent nephrotoxicity and maintain efficacy.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 37) Amphotericin B dose reduction is needed:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Amphotericin B can be nephrotoxic. Dose adjustment is needed even in mild renal failure. Renal function and electrolytes require monitoring.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 38) Acyclovir dose reduction is needed:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Acyclovir is renally cleared. Dose reduction is needed in renal impairment. Adequate hydration and renal monitoring are important.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 39) Cotrimoxazole dose reduction is needed:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Cotrimoxazole is listed under drugs needing dose reduction only in severe renal failure. It is still important to monitor renal function. It is also relevant in G6PD deficiency.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 40) Cefotaxime dose reduction is needed:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Cefotaxime is listed under severe renal failure dose reduction. This differs from cephalexin, which needs reduction even in mild renal failure. Such distinctions are commonly tested.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 41) Ciprofloxacin dose reduction is needed:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Ciprofloxacin is listed as needing dose reduction only in severe renal failure. It also appears in reduced clearance cautions in kidney disease. Renal function should guide dosing.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 42) Metronidazole dose reduction is needed:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Metronidazole is listed under severe renal failure dose reduction. Dose adjustment depends on severity and clinical setting. Renal impairment can alter drug handling.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 43) Which set needs dose reduction even in mild renal failure?
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: These drugs are listed for adjustment even in mild renal failure. Cephalexin, ethambutol and amphotericin B are also in this group. Early dose adjustment helps prevent toxicity.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 44) Which set needs dose reduction only in severe renal failure?
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Cotrimoxazole, cefotaxime and metronidazole are listed under severe renal failure dose reduction. Carbenicillin, norfloxacin and ciprofloxacin are also in this group. They are distinguished from drugs needing adjustment even in mild renal failure.

Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.question: 45) The most accurate statement is:
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.option1: Renal impairment increases toxicity risk of digoxin, lithium and aminoglycosides
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.option2: G6PD deficiency protects against drug-induced haemolysis
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.option3: NSAIDs are always safe in renal disease
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.option4: Warfarin effect is reduced in liver disease
Renal & Hepatic cautions drug, G6PD drug.exp: Renal impairment reduces clearance of several important drugs. Digoxin, lithium and aminoglycosides can accumulate. Dose adjustment and monitoring reduce toxicity risk.
